decks.name: LeetCode #297 - Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
decks.description: Design algorithm to serialize and deserialize binary tree to/from string

cards.question: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree: Serialization is the process of converting a data structure or object into a sequence of bits so that it can be stored in a file or memory buffer, or transmitted across a network connection link to be reconstructed later in the same or another computer environment. Design an algorithm to serialize and deserialize a binary tree. There is no restriction on how your serialization/deserialization algorithm should work. You just need to ensure that a binary tree can be serialized to a string and this string can be deserialized to the original tree structure.

solutions.name: Depth First Search
solutions.explanation: Use DFS preorder traversal for both serialize and deserialize. Serialize: recursively traverse tree in preorder (root, left, right), append node values to result list, use 'N' for null nodes, join with commas. Deserialize: split string by commas, use index to track current position, recursively build tree by reading values in same preorder sequence. When encounter 'N', return None and advance index. O(n) time and space for both operations.

solutions.spaceDescription: Result list/string stores n nodes plus recursion stack depth proportional to tree height
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: Serialize tree [1,2,3,null,null,4,5]: dfs(1) appends '1', dfs(2) appends '2', dfs(null) appends 'N', dfs(null) appends 'N', dfs(3) appends '3', dfs(4) appends '4', dfs(null) appends 'N' twice, dfs(5) appends '5', dfs(null) appends 'N' twice. Result: '1,2,N,N,3,4,N,N,5,N,N'. Deserialize: build root 1, left subtree 2 with null children, right subtree 3 with left child 4 and right child 5.

solutions.name: Breadth First Search
solutions.explanation: Use BFS level-order traversal for both operations. Serialize: use queue starting with root, for each node pop from queue, append value or 'N' to result, add left and right children (even if null) to queue. Deserialize: split string, create root from first value, use queue to track nodes being built, for each node pop from queue and use index to get left and right child values, create children if not 'N' and add to queue. O(n) time and space.
